title: JPMorgan Expands JPM Coin to Ethereum for Institutional Clients
why_it_matters: The expansion places bank deposit money closer to Ethereum collateral and counterparties, broadening institutional settlement choices across the existing EVM ecosystem.
caption:
RWA WIRE // NEWS

JPMorgan Expands JPM Coin to Ethereum for Institutional Clients

Kinexys adds another public network for its USD deposit token, giving bank customers an additional venue for cash transfers alongside tokenized assets.
